name: passmint
description: Firefox and Safari extension that generates strong passwords and passphrases with fine-grained complexity controls.

scripts.test: node --test test/generator.test.js test/theme.test.js test/appearance.test.js test/clipboard.test.js test/safari.test.js test/platform.test.js test/chrome.test.js
scripts.lint: web-ext lint --source-dir=. --ignore-files=test test/** safari/** chrome/** packaging/** build/** node_modules/** web-ext-artifacts/** .claude/**
scripts.start: web-ext run --source-dir=. --ignore-files=test test/** safari/** chrome/** packaging/** build/** node_modules/** web-ext-artifacts/** .claude/**
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir=. --overwrite-dest --ignore-files=test test/** safari/** chrome/** packaging/** build/** icons/png/** node_modules/** web-ext-artifacts/** .claude/** package*.json
scripts.sign: web-ext sign --source-dir=. --ignore-files=test test/** safari/** chrome/** packaging/** build/** icons/png/** node_modules/** web-ext-artifacts/** .claude/** package*.json
